$comment: Spike S2 evaluation set for the EmbeddingProvider port (spec §5.3, §5.4). Every sentence is a self-contained, deixis-free declarative claim (§5.2) about the real repository at /home/kiel/dev/houseworks, drawn from its docs/adr/*, CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, AGENTS.md and src/. Three relations: 'paraphrase' (same proposition, disjoint-ish wording — MUST land above the ~0.70 cosine floor), 'near_miss' (topically adjacent, different proposition — SHOULD land below it), 'polarity' (same proposition negated — expected to embed almost on top of each other; §5.4 is the reason the adjudicator exists, and this set measures how bad it is rather than trying to fix it).

pairs.a: Housework Market expires negotiations lazily on read rather than with a scheduler.
pairs.b: Negotiation expiry in Housework Market happens on the next house touch, not via a background job.

pairs.a: The cleared price is captured at session START and is the only price ever credited or owed.
pairs.b: Only the price captured when a session starts is credited to doers or owed by payers.

pairs.a: The displayed price is the engine price floored to the last daily step boundary.
pairs.b: The board quote is produced by rounding the engine price down to the most recent day boundary.

pairs.a: A step boundary is house-local midnight in the house's configured IANA timezone.
pairs.b: The displayed price advances at midnight in the house's own configured timezone.

pairs.a: sweepNegotiations walks listOpen and applies the domain's expire function inside enterHouse.
pairs.b: Every house entry sweeps open negotiations by running the domain expire function over each one.

pairs.a: The domain layer of Housework Market imports nothing internal and is pure.
pairs.b: No other module inside the codebase is imported by domain; it has no internal dependencies.

pairs.a: The ui layer may import only contract, because HTTP is the only door into the core.
pairs.b: UI code reaches the core solely through contract types, since every call travels over HTTP.

pairs.a: splitByWeight divides a price using floors plus largest remainders, with ties broken by member id.
pairs.b: Price splitting uses largest-remainder rounding and breaks ties deterministically on member id.

pairs.a: presenceMs returns the milliseconds of the accrual window during which a member was present.
pairs.b: The presence calculation reports how long a member was in the house across the accrual window.

pairs.a: aggregateVotes turns reservation-price votes into a task's base price using integer pence arithmetic.
pairs.b: A template's base price is derived from members' reservation-price votes in whole pence.

pairs.a: Consent law binds a member's wallet only with that member's individual consent.
pairs.b: No terms can bind a member financially unless that member has individually consented.

pairs.a: There are no ballots in the Housework Market model and no majority ever binds anyone.
pairs.b: Majority voting is absent from the model, so a majority cannot bind a dissenting member.

pairs.a: Every negotiationView carries a you block of eight booleans computed server-side.
pairs.b: The server computes eight per-viewer consent booleans and attaches them to each negotiation read model.

pairs.a: schema.sql is applied at boot behind a content hash stored in hwm_meta.
pairs.b: Boot applies the SQL schema only after checking a content hash recorded in the hwm_meta table.

pairs.a: Boot throws when the schema.sql hash disagrees with the hash the dev database was created from.
pairs.b: A hash mismatch between the schema on disk and the database causes startup to fail rather than half-migrate.

pairs.a: A TaskInstance is one two-sided expense configured along four orthogonal axes.
pairs.b: Instances are a single model with four independent axes rather than distinct task kinds.

pairs.a: revertReprice restores engine pricing, clears the doer binding, and drops the start-by deadline together.
pairs.b: Undoing an agreed repricing resets the price, the binding and the deadline in one move.

pairs.a: A negotiation permits exactly one counter-proposal, which must move the price toward the countering side's favour.
pairs.b: Only a single direction-constrained counter is allowed per negotiation.

pairs.a: currentPrice is a pure function of template, window anchor and clock, with no ticking infrastructure anywhere.
pairs.b: Price is computed on demand from the template and the current time; nothing ticks in the background.

pairs.a: Two implementations of the same port never import each other in Housework Market.
pairs.b: Sibling adapters behind one port stay mutually independent; only the composition root knows which is wired.

pairs.a: The cleared price is the exact engine price captured at session START.
pairs.b: The displayed price is the engine price floored to the last step boundary.

pairs.a: sweepNegotiations expires open negotiations during the enterHouse preamble.
pairs.b: The enterHouse preamble materialises overdue periods for the house.

pairs.a: The domain layer may import nothing internal.
pairs.b: The main layer may import everything because it is the composition root.

pairs.a: presenceMs measures how long a member was present within an accrual window.
pairs.b: splitByWeight divides a price across weighted shares in integer pence.

pairs.a: A member may be both a payer and a doer of the same instance.
pairs.b: A doer's consent is their action of claiming or starting an instance.

pairs.a: An approved repricing's start-by deadline defaults to twenty-four hours.
pairs.b: A doer's uplift expires at the end of the Review phase.

pairs.a: Standing consent is the house's agreement to a template's terms, given by voting its base price at setup.
pairs.b: Full agreement is reached when every potentially-bound member has accepted the terms.

pairs.a: A bounty is fixed pricing with named payers and open doers.
pairs.b: A standalone offer is fixed pricing with named payers and doer binding to the poster.

pairs.a: Away spans are exact-timestamp intervals of absence that merge when they overlap.
pairs.b: Leaving a house ends standing participation while ledger facts survive.

pairs.a: aggregateVotes takes the floor of the two middle values when the vote count is even.
pairs.b: splitByWeight breaks rounding ties using member id so identical inputs give identical pennies.

pairs.a: The postgres persistence adapter is selected by setting HWM_PERSISTENCE to postgres.
pairs.b: The postgres contract suite todo-skips when HWM_TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset.

pairs.a: The boundaries script runs dependency-cruiser over the whole src import graph.
pairs.b: The check script runs the TypeScript compiler with noEmit.

pairs.a: The moves function projects the consent law from one member's seat.
pairs.b: The potentiallyBound function returns the members whose wallets the proposed terms could bind.

pairs.a: Negotiations are persisted in their own repository alongside instances and templates.
pairs.b: A negotiation has no lifecycle of its own beyond the subject it addresses.

pairs.a: hasLiveSessionElsewhere reuses deriveState rather than re-testing session fields by hand.
pairs.b: deriveState reports whether an instance is cooling, available, in progress or credited.

pairs.a: Frontend copy in Housework Market must be literal and functional, with no soft metaphors.
pairs.b: A design fork implied by a task must be surfaced before code is written, not resolved silently.

pairs.a: The RED half of a TDD pair is committed with HUSKY set to zero.
pairs.b: Commits in this repository use conventional prefixes such as test, feat and fix.

pairs.a: A member with zero presence in the accrual window bears zero share of the cost.
pairs.b: A degenerate accrual window with zero total weight falls back to an equal split.

pairs.a: Fixed pricing on an instance is uncapped by the template's maxPrice.
pairs.b: Engine pricing caps accrued price at the template's maxPrice.

pairs.a: voidAsMoot handles a pending negotiation that stops mattering through nobody's decision.
pairs.b: withdraw is the proposer pulling back their own pending negotiation.

pairs.a: Housework Market uses a background scheduler to expire negotiations.
pairs.b: Housework Market does not use a background scheduler to expire negotiations.

pairs.a: The domain layer may import the app layer.
pairs.b: The domain layer may not import the app layer.

pairs.a: splitByWeight is deterministic for identical inputs.
pairs.b: splitByWeight is not deterministic for identical inputs.

pairs.a: A majority vote can bind a dissenting member's wallet.
pairs.b: A majority vote cannot bind a dissenting member's wallet.

pairs.a: Boot half-migrates the database when the schema hash disagrees.
pairs.b: Boot never half-migrates the database when the schema hash disagrees.

pairs.a: Fixed pricing on an instance is capped by the template's maxPrice.
pairs.b: Fixed pricing on an instance is not capped by the template's maxPrice.

pairs.a: An evidence attachment can be removed or overwritten after upload.
pairs.b: An evidence attachment can never be removed or overwritten after upload.

pairs.a: Two implementations of the same port may import each other.
pairs.b: Two implementations of the same port may never import each other.

pairs.a: The ui layer may import the domain layer directly.
pairs.b: The ui layer may not import the domain layer directly.

pairs.a: A member may sit on both the payer and the doer side of one instance.
pairs.b: A member may not sit on both the payer and the doer side of one instance.

pairs.a: Sessions on one instance can run concurrently for several doers.
pairs.b: Sessions on one instance cannot run concurrently for several doers.

pairs.a: A pending negotiation blocks an ordinary START on its instance.
pairs.b: A pending negotiation does not block an ordinary START on its instance.
